notes:
Move finished backups between drives, and stronger checks before a card says it's safe to format. The way footage is copied and verified is unchanged.

- You can move a finished backup to another drive — every file is checked against the original before anything is removed
- At the end of a run SafeStore re-checks that Dropbox really has everything, and re-uploads anything that went missing
- A card no longer says "safe to format" if its Dropbox copy has been deleted or changed
- Uploads that stop moving now start themselves again
- Reporting a bug from inside the app works again — it used to hang on "Sending…" forever
